c: Fill Configuration item (or Service, or Service offering) on the change.
say: Start by filling the configuration item on the change, or its service or service offering.

c: Choose the tree icon beside the field. A Map tab opens, centred on the CI, five levels deep.
say: Choose the tree icon beside the field. A map tab opens, centred on the item, with five levels of connections around it.

c: The change's CI is kept in Affected CIs. Add every other CI the plans touch, while the change is in New.
say: The change's own item is kept in affected CIs for you. Add every other item the plans touch, while the change is still new. After that, the list is locked.

c: When the change leaves New, Impacted Services/CIs is rebuilt in the background from every affected CI. Services added by hand stay.
say: When the change leaves new, the impacted services are rebuilt in the background from every affected item. Services you added by hand stay.

c: If the work takes a service down, use Create outage on the Outages list.
say: If the work takes a service down, record it with create outage on the outages list.

c: Technical approvers and the CAB read these lists, with the plans, before they decide.
say: Technical approvers and the change advisory board read these lists, with the plans, before they decide.
